Complete dental solutions

Why Kohinoor Dental Clinic

Professional treatment. Personal attention.

Kohinoor Dental Clinic is located at P-16, New Hamza Center, Kohinoor Road, opposite Hockey Stadium, Kohinoor Town, Faisalabad. The clinic provides onsite dental services in a clean and hygienic environment with sterilized instruments.

  • ✓Qualified dental surgeons and experienced clinical team
  • ✓Clean, hygienic environment with sterilized instruments
  • ✓Affordable dental services with appointment-based care
  • ✓Emergency dental pain assessment and relief
  • ✓Wheelchair-accessible parking, restroom and seating
